217156.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
217156.note: Brown’s 2025 report covers its main campus for 2022–2024. This study has no verified count of students living in Brown housing, so housing offenses are shown without a rate per resident.

110404.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
110404.note: Caltech’s 2025 report covers its main campus for 2022–2024. Its relatively small enrollment means a change of only a few reported offenses can noticeably change the rate per 1,000 students.
110404.alias: California Institute of Technology Caltech California

211440.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
211440.note: Carnegie Mellon’s 2026 report covers Pittsburgh and five other locations. Its housing census supports qualified populations for 2022–2024, including separately listed fraternity and sorority residents. Pittsburgh’s 2025 fondling figures conflict with their printed total; affected comparisons remain unavailable.

144050.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
144050.note: Chicago’s 2026 report covers eight locations, including the Gleacher Center and overseas campuses. The Gleacher tables give conflicting totals for 2024 burglary and 2025 aggravated assault, so affected comparisons are unavailable.

190150.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
190150.note: Columbia’s current listing still links its 2025 report, separating seven locations including medical and research facilities and a Paris campus. Earlier figures for the Baker Athletics Complex and Paris were included in Morningside’s off-campus university-property figures. A complete dated student-housing population has not been established.

190415.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
190415.note: Cornell’s 2026 reports cover 2023–2025 for the Ithaca colleges, Cornell Tech and Cornell AgriTech. The university-wide comparison includes all three locations, not just Ithaca.

182670.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
182670.note: Dartmouth’s 2025 report separates Hanover and Lebanon. It counts dating violence within domestic violence, and Lebanon’s 2024 domestic-violence figures by location do not match the printed total; separate comparisons are unavailable.

198419.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
198419.note: Duke’s 2025 report covers its main campus, Marine Lab and Washington program. The main-campus boundary includes hospital and medical research areas, so the count extends beyond undergraduate housing.

134130.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
134130.note: Florida’s 2026 report includes research, medical and teaching locations beyond Gainesville. Local-agency information for Everglades and Vicenza could not support complete 2025 comparisons. The new Jacksonville campus opened in 2026, after the years covered here.

131496.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
131496.note: Georgetown’s 2026 reports cover eight locations, including Dubai and Jakarta. Jakarta opened in January 2025; the earlier years are marked as before opening, rather than as years with zero offenses.

139755.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
139755.note: Georgia Tech’s 2026 report supplies Atlanta, Europe and Savannah tables, while the earlier federal dataset also lists Shenzhen. University-wide rates are unavailable until that difference in locations covered is resolved; the three current tables remain available.
139755.alias: Georgia Tech Georgia Institute of Technology GT Georgia

166027.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
166027.note: Harvard’s 2025 report supplies verified tables for seven locations and 2022–2024. Some branches omit student-housing columns, so complete university-wide housing totals remain unavailable. The housing populations located in this review cover Cambridge only and use different undergraduate and graduate census dates.

145637.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
145637.note: Illinois’ 2025 report covers Urbana-Champaign and the Illini Center. When their reported offenses are combined, the university’s student population is counted once.
145637.alias: UIUC Illinois Urbana-Champaign University of Illinois

162928.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
162928.note: Johns Hopkins’ recovered report is titled 2025, carries an October 2026 issue date and contains 2023–2025 crime tables. Missing geography columns and an unanswered Barcelona police request limit complete university-wide comparisons. The title is preserved rather than treated as the calendar year of every count.

170976.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
170976.note: Michigan’s 2025 report covers Ann Arbor. The explicit 2024 housing-fondling count remains usable, but the campus-wide fondling count conflicts with a footnote. Statutory-rape rows label older years rather than 2024, so the complete combined 2024 total remains unavailable.
170976.alias: UMich University of Michigan U-M Michigan

166683.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
166683.note: The Massachusetts Institute of Technology’s 2025 report provides one campus table. Its 2024 arson figures by location disagree with the printed total, so affected calculations are unavailable; the original numbers remain in the downloadable source records.
166683.alias: MIT Massachusetts Institute of Technology Massachusetts

199120.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
199120.note: North Carolina’s 2026 report covers Chapel Hill and three other locations. Some domestic and dating violence figures are combined, and some smaller-campus tables omit location categories; affected comparisons are unavailable rather than filled with zeroes.
199120.alias: UNC UNC-Chapel Hill University of North Carolina

147767.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
147767.note: Northwestern’s 2026 report covers six locations, including Chicago and overseas campuses. Several Chicago sexual-offense rows repeat a year label; figures with unclear years or missing location categories remain unavailable.

152080.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
152080.note: Notre Dame’s 2025 report covers seven locations, including overseas campuses. Its Chicago and Dublin tables have no student-housing column; missing figures do not establish that no housing offenses occurred.
152080.alias: ND University of Notre Dame Indiana

193900.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
193900.note: New York University’s 2025 reports list 27 locations, including medical and overseas campuses. Tulsa opened in January 2025, after the 2022–2024 statistics covered by these reports. Figures for off-campus residence halls are already included in the off-campus university-property totals and are not added again.
193900.alias: NYU New York University New York

204796.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
204796.note: Ohio State’s 2025 report covers Columbus. The rape and fondling totals include separately identified Richard Strauss reports, so figures for a reporting year can include offenses that occurred many years earlier.

214777.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
214777.note: Penn State’s 2025 reports cover University Park, Dickinson Law and the Hershey College of Medicine. The university-wide comparison includes all three locations, not just University Park.
214777.alias: PSU Penn State Pennsylvania State University Pennsylvania

215062.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
215062.note: Penn’s 2026 report has conflicting year labels in some location tables, and two locations listed in the earlier dataset lack current tables. The study does not treat the main-campus count as a complete university-wide total.

186131.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
186131.note: Princeton’s current 2026 report covers the main campus and James Forrestal Campus for 2023–2025. All overlapping 2023–2024 core-category figures match the previously reviewed 2025 edition. A complete dated housing population has not been established for the resident-rate comparison.

122409.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
122409.note: San Diego State’s current report separates San Diego, Imperial Valley and Georgia. For San Diego in 2024, one housing rape offense is already included in the campus count of one; two more at off-campus university properties bring the combined count to three. A separate correction raises the 2023 housing count from seven to eight.

243744.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
243744.note: Stanford’s main-campus report now covers 2023–2025; overseas reports still use the 2025 edition. Documented housing populations are available for autumn 2023, 2024 and 2025, but university-provided housing has not been matched property by property to crime-reporting locations. Incomplete overseas years and conflicting source figures still prevent some institution-wide rates.

sources.label: 2024 housing population: university-authored report, publisher-hosted copy

228778.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
228778.note: Texas Austin’s 2025 reports cover eight locations, including research and out-of-state facilities. A spring 2024 housing report gives a resident total without establishing that every resident is a student, so that figure is not adopted as the student-population denominator. Some branch crime tables also leave housing cells blank.
228778.alias: UT UT Austin University of Texas

110635.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
110635.note: Berkeley’s main-campus report covers 2022–2024, while the Washington Center’s newer report covers 2023–2025. A complete university-wide count needs both locations; a year available for only one cannot supply that total.
110635.alias: UCB UC Berkeley Berkeley University of California Berkeley California

110644.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
110644.note: Davis’ 2026 report covers Davis and its health campus. It corrects 2024 fondling figures and explains that one disclosure contained repeated incidents; the number of offenses is not the number of different victims.
110644.alias: UCD UC Davis University of California Davis California

110653.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
110653.note: Irvine’s 2025 report covers the university and its medical center for 2022–2024. The study has documented housing populations, but it has not matched every housing property to the locations covered by the crime report.
110653.alias: UCI UC Irvine University of California Irvine California

445188.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
445188.note: Merced’s 2025 report and its 2022–2024 offense tables were recovered and checked. The state audit supplies actual fall housing populations for the same years; the housing properties have not been matched individually to the crime-reporting boundary.
445188.alias: UCM UC Merced University of California Merced California

110671.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
110671.note: Riverside’s 2026 report separates Riverside and Palm Desert. Palm Desert explicitly has no student housing, but its table also omits an off-campus property column without establishing that no such property exists; totals requiring that column remain unavailable.
110671.alias: UCR UC Riverside University of California Riverside California

110680.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
110680.note: San Diego’s 2025 report was reissued in February 2026 and corrects several earlier counts. The current view uses that reissued report, while the earlier federal dataset preserves the older figures; the worked housing example identifies its student population separately.
110680.alias: UCSD UC San Diego University of California San Diego California

110699.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
110699.note: San Francisco’s current statistics cover five locations, including medical campuses in San Francisco, Oakland and Fresno. The university-wide result is not a count for one residential campus, and the housing population has not been matched property by property to the report.
110699.alias: UCSF UC San Francisco University of California San Francisco California

110705.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
110705.note: Santa Barbara’s 2026 report covers 2023–2025. That edition does not confirm the earlier 2022 figures; 2025 counts are available, but the study has no verified same-year student population for calculating rates.
110705.alias: UCSB UC Santa Barbara University of California Santa Barbara California

110714.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
110714.note: Santa Cruz’s 2025 report was reissued in May 2026 with corrections to 2024 domestic-violence entries. It also explains that 21 of the 38 housing rape offenses reported in 2024 came from one disclosure, so the count cannot be relabeled as 38 victims or report forms.
110714.alias: UCSC UC Santa Cruz University of California Santa Cruz California

110662.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
110662.note: Los Angeles’ 2025 report includes dating violence within domestic violence. Separate comparisons for both categories are unavailable because the report does not measure them independently.
110662.alias: UCLA UC Los Angeles University of California Los Angeles California

123961.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
123961.note: Southern California’s 2026 report covers nine locations, including health-sciences, research and Washington facilities. The university-wide comparison combines these locations rather than describing only University Park.

234076.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
234076.note: Virginia’s original 2026 report has now been recovered and checked against all six branch tables for 2023–2025. Its figures match the earlier web extraction, allowing verified cells to enter the comparison. The 2024 Charlottesville fondling count includes 50 incidents disclosed in one report.

236948.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
236948.note: Washington’s 2025 report covers Seattle for 2022–2024. This study does not combine Bothell and Tacoma with Seattle, and it has no verified count of students living in Seattle campus housing for a resident rate.
236948.alias: UW University of Washington Seattle Washington

240444.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
240444.note: Wisconsin’s 2025 report covers Madison for 2022–2024. It is not a statewide university-system total; rates per enrolled student use Madison’s student population.
240444.alias: UW-Madison University of Wisconsin Madison Wisconsin

130794.regionBasis: Institution home location; reporting branches may lie elsewhere.
130794.note: Yale’s 2025 crime reports separate its main campus and West Campus. Both enter this comparison, with the university housing population counted once. Its fall student-resident census covers 2022–2025; a 2025 rate remains unavailable because the crime reports stop at 2024.
